changelog: Phone: in Android Auto (and on car head units and headsets) the buttons next to play/pause went back and forward 10 seconds inside the video. They now go to the previous and the next video. "Previous" from the car always goes to the video played before (it restarts the video only when nothing was played before it).
Phone: skipping again from the car while the next video was still loading was lost; now it skips as soon as the video is ready.

A song opened from a feed (Home, Music, Search, Subscriptions, History...) continued with the next card of that feed, often unrelated music. It now continues with YouTube's related video, like YouTube. Lists with an order of their own (playlists such as Watch later, a channel's videos, Shorts) still play one after another. "Previous" goes back to the video played before instead of the previous card of the feed. Phone and TV.
